title: Other Desert Cities is still in previews on Broadway, and getting to ...
transcript: I got to see five of my favourite TV and film actors together on a Broadway stage and I'm still a little bit in awe. Julia Louis Dreyfus, Ed Harris, Allison Janney, Joe Keery and Lily Rabe are playing a dysfunctional family in other desert cities. Currently in previews at the Hudson Theatre. If you love plays like August, Osage County, Cult of love or Becky Shaw, where families sit around trading insults and reopening old wounds and reveal decades old secrets they've been burying, this one's absolutely for you. It's about a woman who is returning home for Christmas, where she announces she's written and is publishing a memoir on a devastating family tragedy. Her parents, who are former Hollywood power players who became staunch conservatives, have spent years refusing to discuss it. This is a dialogue heavy play filled with rapid fire banter and a lot of fun family dynamics at play. Julia Louis Dreyfus is partic really unreal in her Broadway debut. She plays the impossibly demanding matriarch. It's a perfect role. Other Desert Cities is so funny and so uncomfortable, but ultimately what stuck with me is the idea that even if you share a family, a history, a lifetime of memories, you don't necessarily share the same truth. Currently running until January 17th. Don't miss your chance to see this cast go toe to toe on a Broadway stage.
